import zipfile, re
from xml.etree import ElementTree as ET

ns = {'m': 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main'}
z = zipfile.ZipFile('budget.xlsx')
print([n for n in z.namelist()])

# Shared strings
shared = []
if 'xl/sharedStrings.xml' in z.namelist():
    root = ET.fromstring(z.read('xl/sharedStrings.xml'))
    for si in root.findall('m:si', ns):
        shared.append(''.join(t.text or '' for t in si.iter('{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main}t')))

print('SHARED STRINGS:', shared)

# Workbook sheet order
wb = ET.fromstring(z.read('xl/workbook.xml'))
for sh in wb.findall('m:sheets/m:sheet', ns):
    print('SHEET:', sh.attrib)

# Dump each sheet
for name in z.namelist():
    if re.match(r'xl/worksheets/sheet\d+\.xml', name):
        root = ET.fromstring(z.read(name))
        print('=====', name)
        for row in root.findall('m:sheetData/m:row', ns):
            r = row.attrib.get('r')
            cells = []
            for c in row.findall('m:c', ns):
                ref = c.attrib.get('r')
                t = c.attrib.get('t')
                v = c.find('m:v', ns)
                val = v.text if v is not None else ''
                if t == 's':
                    val = shared[int(val)] if val != '' else ''
                cells.append(f'{ref}={val!r}')
            print('ROW', r, cells)

import zipfile, re
from xml.etree import ElementTree as ET

M = '{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main}'
z = zipfile.ZipFile('budget.xlsx')
print([n for n in z.namelist()])

shared = []
if 'xl/sharedStrings.xml' in z.namelist():
    root = ET.fromstring(z.read('xl/sharedStrings.xml'))
    for si in root.findall(M + 'si'):
        shared.append(''.join(t.text or '' for t in si.iter(M + 't')))

print('SHARED STRINGS:', shared)

wb = ET.fromstring(z.read('xl/workbook.xml'))
for sh in wb.findall(M + 'sheets/' + M + 'sheet'):
    print('SHEET:', sh.attrib)

for name in z.namelist():
    if re.match(r'xl/worksheets/sheet\d+\.xml', name):
        root = ET.fromstring(z.read(name))
        print('=====', name)
        for row in root.findall(M + 'sheetData/' + M + 'row'):
            cells = []
            for c in row.findall(M + 'c'):
                ref = c.attrib.get('r')
                t = c.attrib.get('t')
                v = c.find(M + 'v')
                val = v.text if v is not None else ''
                if t == 's' and val != '':
                    val = shared[int(val)]
                cells.append(ref + '=' + repr(val))
            print('ROW', row.attrib.get('r'), cells)

import zipfile, re
from xml.etree import ElementTree as ET

M = '{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main}'
z = zipfile.ZipFile('budget.xlsx')

shared = []
if 'xl/sharedStrings.xml' in z.namelist():
    root = ET.fromstring(z.read('xl/sharedStrings.xml'))
    for si in root.findall(M + 'si'):
        shared.append(''.join(t.text or '' for t in si.iter(M + 't')))

root = ET.fromstring(z.read('xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml'))
for row in root.findall(M + 'sheetData/' + M + 'row'):
    cells = []
    for c in row.findall(M + 'c'):
        ref = c.attrib.get('r')
        t = c.attrib.get('t')
        v = c.find(M + 'v')
        val = v.text if v is not None else None
        if t == 's' and val is not None:
            val = shared[int(val)]
        elif t == 'inlineStr':
            val = ''.join(x.text or '' for x in c.iter(M + 't'))
        elif t == 'str':
            val = val
        if val == '':
            val = None
        cells.append(ref + '=' + repr(val))
    print('ROW', row.attrib.get('r'), cells)

import zipfile
from xml.etree import ElementTree as ET

M = '{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main}'
z = zipfile.ZipFile('budget.xlsx')
root = ET.fromstring(z.read('xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml'))

expenses = {}
total = 0
for row in root.findall(M + 'sheetData/' + M + 'row'):
    r = int(row.attrib['r'])
    if 11 <= r <= 22:
        cells = {c.attrib['r']: c for c in row.findall(M + 'c')}
        cat = ''.join(x.text or '' for x in cells['A' + str(r)].iter(M + 't'))
        amt = float(cells['C' + str(r)].find(M + 'v').text)
        expenses.setdefault(cat, []).append(amt)
        total += amt

for cat, vals in expenses.items():
    print(f"{cat}: {vals} -> {sum(vals)}")
print("TOTAL EXPENSES:", total)
